sections.title: PFRDA Grade A 2026 — Day 3 — Initial MCQ Bank

explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:01:r1: A credit sale creates an asset (Trade Receivables) and revenue. Debit Trade Receivables ₹80,000; credit Sales ₹80,000.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:03:r1: Section 14 sets out the duties, powers and functions of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), including protection of subscribers' interests.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:04:r1: The Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) maintains central subscriber records and account information. Pension Funds manage investments; the Trustee Bank handles fund flows; the Custodian holds securities.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:05:r1: Section 63 permits specified free reserves, securities premium and capital redemption reserve, but excludes reserves created by revaluation of assets.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:06:r1: Effective capital expenditure adds grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets (about ₹4.93 lakh crore) to direct capital expenditure.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:08:r1: Absolute price elasticity = 5%/10% = 0.5, which is inelastic because it is below 1.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:09:r1: Recognition and achievement are motivators; salary, policy and working conditions are hygiene factors.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:10:r1: Present values are ₹550/1.1 = ₹500 and ₹726/1.1² = ₹600. Total inflows ₹1,100 less ₹1,000 outlay gives NPV +₹100.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:11:r1: Bank, an asset, increases and the receivable asset falls. Debit Bank; credit Trade Receivables.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:12:r1: Section 27 deals with registration of intermediaries.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:13:r1: Supervised learning uses labelled input-output examples.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:14:r1: Section 173(1) requires the first Board meeting within 30 days of incorporation.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:16:r1: A filter bubble is an information environment shaped by personalisation that can repeatedly reinforce similar views and reduce exposure to alternatives.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:17:r1: Material price variance = (Standard Price − Actual Price)×Actual Quantity = (40−38)×500 = ₹1,000 favourable.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:18:r1: The Trustee Bank handles fund flows; the Custodian holds securities/assets in custody.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:19:r1: Inventory, an asset, increases and a liability to the supplier arises. Debit Inventory; credit Trade Payables.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:20:r1: The Economic Survey 2025–26 projected real GDP growth for FY 2026–27 at 6.8–7.2%.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:22:r1: Section 36 provides an appeal to the Securities Appellate Tribunal ordinarily within 45 days. Section 38 provides a further appeal to the Supreme Court on a question of law ordinarily within 60 days, subject to statutory provisions for delay.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:23:r1: STP means Segmentation, Targeting and Positioning.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:26:r1: Multiplier = 1/(1−MPC) = 1/0.25 = 4. MPC means Marginal Propensity to Consume.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:27:r1: Private placement is an offer to identified persons through the statutory process; public advertising is not permitted.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:28:r1: Very high training performance with much weaker independent-test performance is a classic sign of overfitting.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:29:r1: Section 4 provides one Chairperson, not more than three whole-time members and not more than three part-time members. The maxima are important: it is not a requirement that all six non-chair seats always be filled.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-a:q:30:r1: New current assets = ₹5,00,000 and current liabilities = ₹2,00,000; ratio = 2.5:1.
